Title: Increased functionalities to 1-click on Azure Data Explorer is now generally available

Body.Content:
Every user’s journey on Azure Data Explorer (ADX), or any data platform, begins with ingestion. The first step is to define a goal and reduce complexity, in order to create a smooth user experience and process terabytes of information in a couple of minutes.

1-click is a new set of capabilities for enabling a “wizard” experience to define the first ingestion infrastructures. 1-click can also infer table schema based on the user’s dataset, in order to enable schema adjustments with intuitive user experience. With 1-click, users can define: Tables, Mappings, One time and continuous ingestion from multiple sources, each in a supported format.
